answer: Proposal: gate each answer on a fresh enclave attestation. The vendor provisions one key per chip; each quote binds its epoch and account; a public mirror log rejects a second quote from the same chip in an epoch, and each quote is a lantern stamped for one epoch, so replays fail. Thus every identity needs its own rented chip per epoch — linear cost, non-shareable. Cloning gains only while per-answer reward exceeds chip rent, so cap payout at rent; honest margins thin too. Load-bearing timber: vendor keys unextractable. Seams: vendor key leaks, rental price collapse.
